snippet.title: 📢 Hat Kid Joins Fraymakers! 📢 Full Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
It’s about time: Hat Kid from A Hat in Time will be joining Fraymakers as a brand new fighter on September 18th! 🎉 🎉 🎉 

Get Fraymakers: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1420350/Fraymakers/
